claims.quote: Pathogenic variants in SLC6A1 cause a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by developmental delay with behavioral disturbances, seizures, often pharmacoresistant, and a spectrum of movement disorders such as ataxia.

Pathogenic variants in SLC6A1 cause a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by developmental delay with behavioral disturbances, seizures, often pharmacoresistant, and a spectrum of movement disorders such as ataxia.
Three (50%) patients achieved full seizure remission, and the remaining three patients had a reduction in seizure frequency ranging from 50 to 90%.
Three out of four patients with baseline ataxia showed improvement.
Caregivers noted improvement in social interaction and school engagement in five out of six patients.
Except for weight loss in one patient, no serious adverse effects were reported.
ACZ may offer a promising therapeutic option for drug-resistant SLC6A1-related seizures.
